title: May 1, 1969: Fred Rogers testifies before the Senate Subcommittee on Communications
summary: Seven-minute footage of Fred Rogers testifying before a US Senate subcommittee in 1969 to defend federal funding for the new Corporation for Public Broadcasting. A skeptical Senator Pastore starts out abrasive and is won over during Rogers' brief, calm testimony.
why: HN commenters hold it up as a model of persuasive public speaking and as the go-to reminder of why public broadcasting deserves funding.

quote.text: Fred Rogers' 1969 testimony before the Senate in defense of PBS funding is very moving.
